0022600163.text: The 76ers (6-1, 3-1 at home, 1st in the Atlantic and the East, on a three-game winning streak) host the Bulls (1-5, 0-2 at home, 14th in the East, 4 games back in the Central, and on a four-game losing streak) in their 8th game of the season. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Joel Embiid (foot), and LeBron James (back), while Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring) and has Dailyn Swain listed as day-to-day with back soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the 76ers lost 1-2 to the Bulls in the 2025-26 season, but Philadelphia won their most recent meeting 157-137 in Philadelphia on March 25, 2026.
